nowLine: now:'v13.45: B AND I OPEN THE BACKPACK, O ORDERS YOUR HIRE. - B and I both open and close the backpack, in a raid and in the Undercroft, and neither pauses. Either also closes the peddler stall. - B no longer backs out of windows or panels; TAB does. - O gives the hired man his next order: loot, follow, hold. B no longer does. - Every backpack label says B / I, the full key list has an O row for the hire, the backpack panel says B or I to close, and the what-is-new card leads with TAB pausing and backing out, B and I opening the backpack, and O giving orders. - Controller players see no change: pads never had an orders button, and View already taps I.',

edits.old: 'PRESS B TO BACK OUT OF ANY MENU, OR TAB, WHICH ALSO PAUSES. Either closes whatever is in front, one thing per press, in the Undercroft and on the surface. B with nothing open still gives your hire his orders. The backpack is on I.',
